items.detail: LEGACY 2003-01-02 to 2018-12-21 (4022 sessions); RAW 2022-03-07 to 2024-12-23 (705 sessions); CONFIG equals the manifest in both eras. The manifest is a derived artifact, not an approved frozen document.
Disclosed in section_4_3_closing_report_addendum_availability_20261031T033403Z.json with the quoted lines of load_development.

Formula check on the current code PASS (81/81); bias check (mean of RV minus BV, simulated Gaussian windows): w=15: unscaled 0.9934, scaled -0.007; w=30: unscaled 0.9985, scaled -0.0024; w=60: unscaled 1.0148, scaled 0.015. RAW sensitivity redundancy: keep 83 / drop 30 (before 83 / 30), newly kept none, newly dropped none. Primary set: unchanged (no jump_variation column is in the primary pool). F4 was not rerun for this change. Reading used: the scaling is applied to the bipower term inside jump_variation_w; the bipower_w column is unchanged.

Rule-based reading: inconclusive. Ex-dividend gap in the mean overnight return: LEGACY 0.3061% (SE 0.1233%, 57 sessions, t 2.48); RAW -0.7405% (SE 0.12%, 12 sessions, t -6.17). The two gaps have opposite signs, and the ex-date approximation (third Friday of March, June, September, December) coincides with quarterly options expiration, so this test does not settle the question. Price levels: LEGACY first close 62.12 on 2003-01-02, last TRAIN close 229.57; junction ratio 0.99845 (first RAW Open 431.57 over last LEGACY Close 432.24), a normal one-day move. Inference, not established from the repository: a LEGACY close of about 62 on 2003-01-02, against a level near 90 recalled from general knowledge, and a junction ratio near 1 would both fit closes back-adjusted for dividends up to about March 2022; if so, amihud_w dollar volume is understated in early years. Nothing was changed.
